name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention; accurately describes counting active (alive, non-quest, non-boss) characters filtered by a team id. No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix matching own/data address). All embedded constants (0x79, 10, team 0/1/2) are domain semantics, not addresses.
purpose: Count the 'actively usable' characters belonging to a given team (alive, non-quest-portrait, non-boss/special), used to render each team's surviving headcount in the Party Status Overview.
logic_summary: count=0; for i in 0..data_fd2_battle_party_member_count-1: let pc = &data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr[i] (80/0x50-byte runtime_char stride); if pc.team(+0x06)==team AND pc.portrait_id(+0x07)!=0x79 (exclude hidden/quest portrait) AND pc.archetype_flag(+0x1F)!=10 (exclude boss/special unit) AND fd2_check_char_is_dead(i)==0 (alive): count++. return count. Loop exit and accumulator return share the POP/RET epilogue at entry+0x5C (0x0001B64D), which fd2_collect_dead_char_drops and fd2_collect_pending_death_drops reuse as a borrowed epilogue via their own loop-exit JGE.

params.name: param_1
params.semantics: Team id to filter by (0=enemy, 1=npc ally, 2=player). Caller fd2_render_party_status_overview_content passes literal 0, 2, then 1. Compared against runtime_char.team (+0x06).
params.reason: Ghidra param is the generic placeholder 'param_1'; it represents the team selector. src already declares it as 'team'; sync the Ghidra param name in Stage 2. No address residue but generic placeholder requires rename per param rule.

returns.semantics: Number of matching active (alive, non-quest, non-boss) characters on the requested team.

notes: src comment block (btl_turn.c lines 780-788) is already a concise, accurate ASCII English summary that matches the disassembly; kept unchanged. Disassembly verified: fields +0x06 team, +0x07 portrait_id (vs 0x79), +0x1F archetype_flag (vs 0xa); callee 0x0003453e = fd2_check_char_is_dead; loop counter EBX, accumulator ESI, team in EDI from [ESP+0x10]. Ghidra plate is detailed and consistent with the function's purpose/logic, so left untouched. Minor wording note (not changed, no src contradiction): the plate calls the epilogue-sharing borrowers 'tail-JMP', but the two borrowers (fd2_collect_pending_death_drops @0x1b6d5 JGE rel32, fd2_collect_dead_char_drops @0x1b671 JGE rel8) reach 0x1b64d via conditional loop-exit jumps rather than unconditional tail JMPs; the epilogue-reuse fact itself is correct. Only the shard file is staged for this symbol since comment_verdict=keep.
